title: Fairly Vs Rather
theory:
1 Fairly (Adverb)
  Fairly is an adverb. It is used to qualify a Neutral / Positive tone
pleasant adjective. It means "to a moderate
 degree" (neither too much nor too little).

 2 Rather (Adverb)
  Rather is an adverb. It is used to qualify an
unpleasant adjective. It means to a higher Negative / Surprising tone
 degree than expected (often shows surprise,
 emphasis, or something unusual).
